house: @house is a group named "house": a box 4 m (x) by 3 m (y) by 2.4 m tall, one corner at the origin (x 0..4, y 0..3, z 0..2.4). @top is its top face. The house is the selected group.
room: @room is a group named "Wall": a closed room, walls 0.2 m thick and 2.4 m high, centerline 6 m (x) by 4 m (y) from the origin (outer size 6.2 x 4.2).
pair: @a is a group named "a": a 1 m cube at the origin (x 0..1). @b is a group named "b": a 1 m cube at x 3..4. Both start at y 0..1, z 0..1.
lot: @lot is a flat rectangular face on the ground, 10 m (x) by 8 m (y), corner at the origin.
block: A loose (ungrouped) box 4 m (x) by 3 m (y) by 2.4 m tall, corner at the origin. @top is its top face. Its front face (facing -y) is the one at y = 0.
facade: @facade is a flat vertical face in the plane y = 0, 6 m wide (x 0..6) and 3 m tall (z 0..3): the front of a building.
tower: @tower is a group named "tower": a box 2 m by 2 m and 6 m tall at the origin (x 0..2, y 0..2, z 0..6). @top is its top face.
moved: @house is a group named "house", a 4 m (x) by 3 m (y) by 2.4 m box. The last thing done was: move the house 5 m east (it now sits at x 5..9, y 0..3, z 0..2.4). Undo takes back that move.
wide: @house is a group named "house", a box 4 m wide (x) by 3 m (y) by 2.4 m tall, corner at the origin. The last request was "a house 4 meters wide".
roomdoor: @room is a closed room (group "Wall"), walls 0.2 m thick and 2.4 m high, centerline 6 m (x) by 4 m (y) from the origin. @door is a group named "door": a flat door panel 1 m wide, 2.1 m tall, 0.1 m thick on the south wall at x 2.5..3.5, y -0.05..0.05. South is -y, north is +y, west is -x, east is +x.
northwall: @nwall is the north wall of a room as one flat vertical face in the plane y = 4, from x 0 (west end, the left end) to x 6 (east end) and z 0..2.4. South is -y, north is +y, west is -x, east is +x.
post: @post is a group named "Column": a 0.3 m square column 3 m tall standing at the origin (centered on x 0, y 0).
